objectives.text: Find Mother's letter by the cottage.
Align the three discs on the Rune Pedestal.
Discover the awakened path to Briarwood.
Cross the Briarwood threshold to depart.

caelen.speaker: MASTER CAELEN
before_pedestal: Did you hear it, Aren? Twelve chimes bind the Veilstorm... yet tonight the belfry shuddered under a thirteenth toll.
Something stone-old just woke in the square. Inspect the Stone Rune Pedestal first, before the night mist thickens.
investigation: Thirteen chimes... Three hundred years of twelve, and tonight the iron tongue struck one beat too many.
Look at our neighbors' eyes, Aren. Whenever the Great Bell shields Bellhaven, it drinks a piece of our memories in return.
Before your mother Elena vanished toward Dawnspire, she feared the ward was failing and locked her final chart inside the survey chest beside the cottage.
Take my brass key to the chest. Remember her first cipher clue too: the pedestal's OUTER RING is tuned to the MOON.
after_puzzle: The golden beam points southwest into Briarwood Forest. Take your compass, Aren, and walk carefully past the old mile-markers.
Your mother believed Ashvale deserved a dawn where nobody has to forget. Find Lyra in the woods and uncover what Elena started.

mira.speaker: MIRA THE BLACKSMITH
before_pedestal: Careful near the hearth, Aren! That thirteenth chime rattled every sword and horseshoe off my racks.
The Rune Pedestal by the eastern cobbles started humming right after the echo faded. Go take a look at it.
investigation: Warm yourself by the forge, Aren. Village life stays quiet here—bake bread, mend plows, bank the fire—until curfew falls.
Only lately, neighbors keep forgetting old songs and names after twilight. Folks blame the mist, but your mother Elena suspected the Bell itself.
When Elena repaired the Stone Rune Pedestal years ago, I tempered its bronze axle for her. She swore the MIDDLE RING must point straight to the SUN.
after_puzzle: Wait till the smithy hears that you woke the old stone! When that golden ray shot southwest, every ember in my furnace leaped.
Briarwood's trail has stood thorn-shut for years. Watch your step and give Historian Lyra my regards if she's still camped under the oaks.

elara.speaker: SISTER ELARA
before_pedestal: Blessings upon you, young mapmaker. Have you seen the square's stone pedestal? Its sleeping glyphs caught fire at the thirteenth stroke.
Go inspect the Stone Rune Pedestal before my chronicle ink dries, then come speak with us.
investigation: Those symbols on the pedestal predate the kingdom's founding—ancient Beacon script from before the Great Bell was ever hung.
Your mother Elena worked closely with the young historian Lyra to map three lost Ancient Beacons capable of holding back the Veilstorm without taking memories.
If the thirteenth bell means the pact is cracking, only the Ancient Beacons can spare Ashvale.
Our belfry ledger notes that the pedestal's INNER RING belongs to the Dawnspire STAR. Check Elena's letter by the cottage before aligning the stones.
after_puzzle: I have only ever seen Beacon script illuminated in dusty manuscripts! You brought Bellhaven's oldest ward back to life.
Follow the southwest lantern path to Briarwood Waystone. Lyra's survey notes place the First Ancient Beacon deep in those mist-bound woods.

mothers_letter: "My dear Aren—if the Great Bell ever tolls thirteen times, know that Caelen and I kept silent only to keep you safe."
"The historian Lyra and I traced three Ancient Beacons built before the Bell's curse. I set off toward Briarwood to verify the first beacon's hearth."
"Align the pedestal discs from outer edge to heart: MOON for the watch, SUN for the forge, STAR for Dawnspire. Follow the light west to find us."
beacon_revelation: Golden-cyan light surges through the carved obelisk, casting a shimmering surveyor's ray southwest across the Bellhaven cobbles.
Memories etched into the stone flicker clear: three Ancient Beacons once shielded Ashvale in harmony, until the Great Bell trapped the valley in amnesia.
The first of the three Ancient Beacons sleeps deep inside Briarwood Forest—the very region your mother Elena and Lyra entered before she vanished.
briarwood_ending: The silver-barked briars uncoil from the weathered stone gate, revealing an old cartographer's brass compass mark pressed neatly into the moss.
Aren recognizes his mother's hand-stamped seal—and beside it, fresh chalk notation from Historian Lyra pointing toward the forest interior.
Taking a steady breath, Aren fastens his scroll satchel and steps toward the misty eaves of Briarwood to uncover the First Beacon and bring Elena home.
